# Coverage Matrix — source → spec

**Area:** `TRACE` · **Status:** complete · **Generated by:** the traceability pass (grep over `docs/specs`, verified by hand)

Every product source file in the repository is listed once below with exactly one **owner spec** (the spec whose
"Sources owned" header lists it, or the owner the README ownership table assigns), the other specs that mention it
("referenced by"), and a status. The corpus is complete when every file has one owner and every non-infra file is
cited by that owner; both hold (see the checks at the end).

## Summary

| Count | Value |
|---|---|
| Files enumerated | 165 |
| Owned (product intent, cited by the owner spec) | 148 |
| Infra only (no product intent; listed for completeness) | 11 |
| Unused component (present in source, imported nowhere or never rendered) | 6 |
| Files with zero owners | 0 |
| Files with more than one owner after resolution | 0 |
| Product files (excluding `package.json`, `base44/config.jsonc`, and the seven build/lint configs) | 156, of which 151 are mentioned in at least one spec; the five unmentioned are the `src/` infra files below |

**Scope.** Everything under `src/` except `src/components/ui/**` (generated UI primitives) and `src/.DS_Store`;
every file under `base44/entities`, `base44/functions`, `base44/workflows`; plus `index.html`, `package.json`,
`base44/config.jsonc`, `vite.config.js`, `tailwind.config.js`, `components.json`, `eslint.config.js`,
`jsconfig.json`, `postcss.config.js`.

**Status meanings.**
- **Owned** — the owner spec cites the file with `[Implemented]`/`[Partial]` statements.
- **Infra only** — the file carries no product behaviour (SDK client, query client, class-name helper, viewport hook,
  page-URL helper, build and lint configuration). The owner is `20-features/app-shell` by the README table
  ("config files"); the app-shell spec does not describe these files and no other spec cites them.
- **Unused component** — the file exists but no route renders it; the owner spec records the finding as `[Partial]`
  and the note gives the finding's id.

**Spec name abbreviations in "Referenced by".** `arch/x` = `10-architecture/x.md`; `arch/data-model/x` =
`10-architecture/data-model/x.md`; `ov/x` = `00-overview/x.md`; `feature` = `20-features/feature/spec.md`;
`feature/sub` = `20-features/feature/sub.md`. `90-traceability/*`, `README.md`, `_template-feature-spec.md`
and `_writer-brief.md` are excluded from the reference counts.

## Package dependencies with product-sounding names

`package.json` declares 65 runtime dependencies. The app-shell spec (§11 "Dependencies with no product intent")
already lists the unused ones; this table repeats the verification for the traceability record. "Imported" means
a `from '<package>'` import under `src/` outside `src/components/ui/`.

| Package | Imported under `src/` (outside `ui/`) | Finding |
|---|---|---|
| `@stripe/react-stripe-js`, `@stripe/stripe-js` | no | No payment, plan or subscription feature; the landing page states "Get Started — It's Free" (`00-overview/product-vision.md` §5, `20-features/app-shell` §11) |
| `three` | no | No 3-D feature |
| `react-leaflet` | no | No map feature |
| `react-quill` | no | No rich-text editor; every text field is a plain input or textarea |
| `html2canvas`, `jspdf` | no | No PDF export; export is print/email (`10-architecture/export-print-email.md`) |
| `canvas-confetti` | no | No celebratory effect anywhere (`20-features/vision-board/spec.md` §7a records "no confetti") |
| `react-markdown`, `moment`, `lodash`, `zod` | no | Imported nowhere at all, `ui/` included |

Visualisation and interaction libraries that **are** used, with the feature that owns the behaviour:

| Package | Imported by | Feature |
|---|---|---|
| `recharts` | `src/components/visionboard/WeeklyReview.jsx` (and the `ui/chart` primitive) | `20-features/vision-board/weekly-review.md` §5 (seven-day chart) — the spec describes what the chart shows, not the library |
| `framer-motion` | `src/components/visionboard/Slideshow.jsx` | `20-features/vision-board/slideshow.md` §4.3 (Ken Burns zoom, crossfade) |
| `@hello-pangea/dnd` | `src/pages/Dashboard.jsx`, `src/pages/DailyChecklist.jsx` | `20-features/dashboard` §4.3 (widget reorder), `20-features/daily-checklist` §4.6 (drag within and across buckets) |
| `date-fns` | most pages | date formatting; rules in `10-architecture/time-and-date-semantics.md` |
| `@tanstack/react-query`, `react-router-dom`, `lucide-react`, `react-hook-form`, `@radix-ui/*`, `embla-carousel-react`, `next-themes`, `cmdk`, `vaul`, `input-otp`, `sonner`, `react-hot-toast`, `react-resizable-panels`, `react-day-picker` | app plumbing or `src/components/ui/` primitives only | no feature-level behaviour derives from them |

## Checks performed

1. **Enumeration** — `find src -type f -not -path 'src/components/ui/*'` (minus `.DS_Store`), `find base44 -type f`, plus the nine root files: 165 paths.
2. **Owner lookup** — every "Sources owned" / "Sources" / "Source file" header in `docs/specs` was extracted; each file was assigned to the header that names it, with dual listings resolved per the table above.
3. **Owner cites file** — for every file with status Owned or Unused component, `grep -F <basename>` over the owner spec finds at least one citation. Result: 154 of 154.
4. **Reference list** — `grep -rlF <basename> docs/specs` for every file, excluding `90-traceability`, `README.md`, and the two `_` files; the owner is removed from the list. Backend functions are matched by directory name (`autoSync`), workflows by file name.
5. **Unused components** — for each of the six, the owner spec's `[Partial]` finding was located and its id recorded in the Note column.
6. **Dependency imports** — `grep -rl "from '<pkg>'" src` with and without `src/components/ui/`.

## Unresolved

None. No file has zero owners; no file kept two owners after the resolutions above.
